svg.text: DOFUS FORGE · DEFINITIVE IDENTITY · R8
Marks in the site's own language: gold on a void tile with a gold filet, Cinzel small caps. C2–C5 refine The Forge Egg; C5 recommended.
A · The Slot
The planner's class slot becomes the logo: a gold-framed
tile on the element ring, a Dofus inside.
B · Forged Dofus
A faceted gold Dofus resting on a steel anvil — the
build, forged. Gold and steel, straight from the UI.
C · The Forge Egg
One gold Dofus with the anvil and a ◆ spark cut out of
it: the forge lives inside the egg.
C2 · The Forge Egg · Premium
Polished gold Dofus with the anvil engraved into it, lit
from inside by the forge, and a burning ◆ spark.
C3 · Molten Dofus
A dark steel Dofus split by molten gold seams that burst
from a white-hot anvil inside it.
C4 · Fabergé Forge
A navy enamel Dofus banded in gold like a Fabergé egg,
the four element gems on its belt and an anvil
medallion.
C5 · Molten Dofus · Forged
A hammered-iron Dofus split by four seams glowing in the
element colours, white-hot at the anvil, crowned and set
on gold.
RECOMMENDED
